description: This file defines a TorchScript-compatible functional Rprop optimizer class for PyTorch, intended for distributed training scenarios. It includes initialization and a step method that updates parameters based on provided gradients, emphasizing distributed and multithreaded contexts.

classes.name: _FunctionalRprop
classes.description: A TorchScript-compatible functional Rprop optimizer designed for distributed PyTorch training. It manages parameters, gradients, and optimizer state, allowing parameter updates without accumulating gradients directly on the parameters.

methods.name: __init__( self, params: list[Tensor], lr: float = 1e-2, etas: tuple[float, float] = (0.5, 1.2), step_sizes: tuple[float, float] = (1e-6, 50), foreach: bool = False, maximize: bool = False, _allow_empty_param_list: bool = False, )
methods.description: Initializes the _FunctionalRprop optimizer with parameters, learning rate, eta factors, step sizes, and other options. Sets up internal state and validates input.

methods.name: step(self, gradients: list[Tensor | None])
methods.description: Performs an optimization step by updating parameters based on the provided gradients, handling state initialization, and invoking the Rprop function from torch.optim._functional.
